notes.title: Beat 'Em Up Collection Update
notes.content: [p]Hello, street fighters! We have some news about the game![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649306/fe5578b0eab25106a9aa779a4ad832440ea7b2cd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]1 - An option has been added to the settings allowing players to enable or disable the rewind feature.[/p][p]2 - A written interview (in the trivia section) and over 60 images have been added to the Gourmet Sentai game gallery section.[/p][p]Have fun and keep fighting![/p]
